name: Mara Osei
bio: Captain of the Freighter Mk2; ex-navy, keeps the crew's manifest by heart.
voice: Navy cadence: short declaratives, no small talk. Dry rather than wry; a joke from her is one flat word. She expects the point and gives it, decides fast and says so once, then does not revisit. The crew answer in fewer words when she is in the room, and a pause from her reads as disapproval.
